ruleDefinitions.name: Hiding User Account Via SpecialAccounts Registry Key
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modifications to the registry key "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\SpecialAccounts\Userlist" where the value is set to "0" in order to hide user account from being listed on the logon screen. Note: Unmapped fields: Details
